item.title: Netanyahu, Trump and Gulf leaders discuss major security upgrade after Iranian fire at UAE
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has spoken in recent days with several Gulf leaders, including United Arab Emirates President Mohammed bin Zayed, to coordinate positions regarding the situation with Iran. item.title: Turkey unveils long-range ballistic missile with 6,000 km range
item.description:
unveiled the Yıldırım intercontinental ballistic missile at the SAHA 2026 defense expo in Istanbul, showcasing a system with a declared range of 6,000 kilometers (3,728 miles) and a top speed of Mach 25.
